reason: Reviewed the skill, harness setup reference, CLI readiness and login surfaces together after machine approval became resumable. An unattended or --json init now starts one approval, polls once and returns; its credential state carries technical.pairing (approve_url, code, expires_at) and a named pairing_outcome (pending, denied, expired, not_started), and the next run resumes the same handshake, which the service alone can expire. The skill and reference no longer say to keep the command running; they tell the agent to relay the page and code in the fixed T2 wording of the public setup instructions (app.notifai.sh/setup.md), which also fixes the words for the no-access, companion app, permission, hook trust, denied and expired handoffs. The devices and no-access states carry structured technical fields (companion_setup_url, account_email, devices, access_url) so those templates need no paraphrase. An adversarial review found and fixed the duplicate-machine risk after a late approval, the silent re-ask after denial, the unrelayed Codex hook approval, and the summary-not-document fetch. No new agent commands, settings, or trust changes were introduced; hook mechanics, wake routing and acknowledgement rules are unchanged.
